Know before you order

The details
make the difference.

What is included in the sheet set?

One fitted sheet, one flat sheet, and four pillowcases. Pillows are sold separately.

Which sizes are listed?

Queen fitted sheet: 60 × 80 inches. King fitted sheet: 76 × 80 inches. Confirm pocket depth and pillowcase dimensions when calling.

What is the fabric composition?

Bamboo Solid 2000 Series is the product name. Ask for the current package fiber label before ordering; exact composition and thread count are not verified here.

Can I add pillows?

The original site lists Cool Comfort Bamboo Pillows at $40 per Queen set and $50 per King set. Call to confirm current prices and how many pillows are included.

How do I pay and receive my order?

Orders are arranged by phone. Confirm accepted payment methods, collection or shipping, delivery timing, and returns before paying. No online payment is collected on this page.

How should I care for my set?

Follow the care label on the exact set you receive. Ask about washing and drying instructions before ordering if you have specific requirements.
